event_summary: A green sheet between two handle-like tools separates into two green pieces that move apart and bend.
raw_event_description: At the start, a bright green thin sheet lies across a wooden tabletop with its left and right upper corners near dark pointed ends of two black-and-blue handle-like tools. For several moments the sheet remains broadly flat with a slight curve along its front edge. A gap then becomes visible near the upper middle area, the green sheet bends and curls upward, and the left and right portions pull away from each other. The left portion tilts and shifts leftward while the right portion arches and shifts rightward. By the end, two separate green pieces remain apart on the tabletop, each near one of the side tools.

reasons: The green sheet, both side tools, and tabletop are visible.
The sheet is not yet separated in the first frame.
The contact areas between the sheet and the side tools are visible near the upper corners.
